preview_behavior: Whitespace-only preview text is ignored before falling back to richer extracted text sources.
Extracted content is rendered as structured preview blocks instead of one raw preformatted blob.
Headings, paragraphs, lists, and table-like rows are visually separated for easier scanning.
Long previews show a readability note when truncation is applied.
Sparse or low-confidence extraction is flagged in the preview note.
preserved_behavior: Existing file preview endpoint compatibility was not changed.
Existing extracted text storage was not changed.
Client Workspace remains read-only for inspection.
risks: Heading/list/table heuristics may occasionally over-classify unusual prose or OCR output.
The preview cap may hide content beyond the readability window for very long files.
rollback_note: Revert the shared preview files and component-specific preview CSS if the new formatting needs to be removed.
recommended_next_task: Review the next pm:ready / hermes:ready issue when it appears.
